rows.label: tlk70000049_05_msg001
rows.name:
Somewhere deep down, I knew it
would come to this someday.

rows.label: tlk70000049_05_msg002
rows.name:
My lieges, I will no longer ask you
to keep yourselves out of danger.

rows.label: tlk70000049_05_msg003
rows.name:
I ask you only to seize
victory in your mission,
and return here to Aletta.

rows.label: tlk70000049_05_msg004
rows.name:
I look forward to the day when
I see you return triumphant.

rows.label: tlk70000049_05_msg005
rows.name:
And, Adel-sama... I've served you for
about twenty years now...

rows.label: tlk70000049_05_msg006
rows.name:
You let me serve at your side,
when I had only knowledge. I
have yet to repay that debt.

rows.label: tlk70000049_05_msg007
rows.name:
Please don't take away this old man's
reason for living.
